mapper.select: SELECT /*selectBuyerMpRqRequestQuotationImSList*/ A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.RECV_FLAG, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.BTOA_DATE, A.BTOA_END_DATE, A.BTOA_USER_ID, A.BTOA_USER_NAME, A.BTOA_USER_DEPT, A.BTOA_USER_TEL, A.BTOA_USER_MAIL, A.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, A.ITEM_QTY, A.BTOA_REMARK, A.IMAGE_KEY, A.REG_ITEM_NO, A.CATEGORY_NO, A.ITEM_GUBUN, A.REVISION, A.ITEM_TYPE, A.YEAR_QTY FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.BUYER= #{st_buyer} AND A.RECV_FLAG = 'TS' AND A.BTOA_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ
